method: SEC Form N-PX structured filings (every filing for each period; an amendment replaces the records it restates). Only shareholder proposals. A vote matches a proposal at the same company and meeting (or the same year when the meeting date is not on file) when at least 75% of the title's key words appear in the filing's description, at least 50% the other way, and it beats the next-best proposal at that meeting by 0.15. Anything close but not certain goes to the review list.

meta-2026-3.reason: Meta's 2026 ballot had two AI-data proposals: Item 3 (AI Data Usage Oversight, National Legal and Policy Center) and Item 11 (Data Protection Impact Assessment on Generative AI Chatbots, Mercy Investment Services). Some fund filings describe both as AI data usage oversight, so their votes on the two cannot be told apart.
